title: Cabbage Core Sanctuary
description: A detailed surreal illustration of a large green cabbage cut in cross-section, revealing a dark circular core. Inside the core, a small silhouetted figure with a glowing red lower body stands surrounded by floating golden coins and orbs, while various black insects crawl on the outer leaves.
